macros.name: GDabstracts
macros.doc: This command marks the beginning of the “content” section, beginning with the English and French abstracts.

macros.name: GDarticlestart
macros.doc: The working paper begins with this command. It handles some final fine-tuning of the formatting settings.

macros.name: GDauthorsCopyright
macros.doc: List of the authors’ last names for the authors’ copyright notice at the bottom of the title page.

macros.name: GDauthorsShort
macros.doc: List of authors, formatted as [First initial]. [Last name] (e.g.: B. Hamel, K. Hébert).

macros.name: GDcoverpage
macros.doc: The entire cover page is generated with this command.

macros.name: GDmonth
macros.doc: Publication month of the working paper in both French and English.

macros.name: GDnumber
macros.doc: Number assigned to the working paper by the GERAD team.

macros.name: GDrevised
macros.doc: When a working paper is revised by its authors, this command is used to display the revision date on the cover page.

macros.name: GDsupplementname
macros.doc: If you write extra research data or an appendix using the geradwp template and the gdsupplement option (see subsection 2.1), the \GDsupplementname command will serve as place holder for the supplement’s name and the class will output it on the title pages and on page headers.

macros.name: GDyear
macros.doc: The year the paper was published, formatted as YYYY.

envs.name: GDaffillist
envs.doc: The GDaffillist environment is a customized list of all the authors’ affiliations, in no predefined order of importance.

envs.name: GDaffillist
envs.doc: The GDaffillist environment is a customized list of all the authors’ affiliations, in no predefined order of importance.

envs.name: GDauthlist
envs.doc: The GDauthlist environment is a customized list in which the authors enter their full name using the \GDauthitem command (NB: one author per line).

envs.name: GDauthlist
envs.doc: The GDauthlist environment is a customized list in which the authors enter their full name using the \GDauthitem command (NB: one author per line).

envs.name: GDemaillist
envs.doc: The final customized list created for the title page of a Cahier is the GDemaillist environment, where the authors’ email addresses are listed, with one email address per \GDemailitem command.

envs.name: GDemaillist
envs.doc: The final customized list created for the title page of a Cahier is the GDemaillist environment, where the authors’ email addresses are listed, with one email address per \GDemailitem command.
